parent_objective: synthesize M1510-M1519 bounded-runner evidence before any further implementation
blocked_by: workflow synthesis cadence reached after 10 non-synthesis bounded-runner milestones
supersedes: direct timing-amplified implementation without branch synthesis

public_gates: M1520 must synthesize M1510-M1519 before the bounded-runner branch continues
M1520 must separate trace plumbing, retargeting, decision-step interventions, and timing-amplified design evidence
M1520 must state supported and falsified claims
M1520 must assess public-gate overfit risk
M1520 must choose continue, pivot, stop, or promote_to_next_branch

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M1510-M1519 bounded fixed-policy runner, source retarget, T5 intervention, and timing-amplification design evidence before another implementation milestone
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no implementation smoke, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if synthesis treats M1517 null/weak interventions as self-ID evidence
stop if synthesis ignores branch cadence or public overfit risk
stop if synthesis admits corpus export or training before outcome-relevant intervention evidence
stop if synthesis skips the decision between timing amplification and terminal-boundary retarget repair
fallback_plan: continue to a new timing-amplified intervention implementation branch if M1519 is judged the highest-leverage next test
pivot to terminal-boundary retarget repair if M1517/M1518 show rows remain too safe
stop or close the T5 subset if current evidence suggests weak history-necessity signal
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1519 reaches the cadence limit for paper_route_decisive_history_bounded_runner

admission_evidence: M1510-M1519 completed bounded runner design/implementation/audit, source retarget design/implementation/audit, T5 decision-step intervention design/implementation/audit, and timing-amplified design
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1520 is synthesis and must not convert retarget or intervention plumbing into level3 self-identification evidence.
history_necessity_tests: synthesize whether M1517 decision-step interventions are informative
synthesize whether M1519 timing amplification is justified
separate null/weak intervention evidence from supported infrastructure claims
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If synthesis judges current T5 probes uninformative, pivot or stop before adding more narrow intervention tweaks.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: After M1519, the bounded-runner branch should synthesize evidence before any timing-amplified implementation continues.
success_criteria: supported and falsified claims are explicit
training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, materialization, and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: synthesis treats intervention plumbing or sub-threshold effects as self-ID evidence
synthesis routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, actor-input changes, or candidate materialization
decision_rule: M1520 passes if it synthesizes M1510-M1519 and chooses the next route before more bounded-runner implementation work.
